name: Abaújkér (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a serrated border of blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Abaújkér: a blue shield with a white charge, with red and blue mantling and a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Abaújkér arms with mantling and scroll
